charts.title: Kepler-538 b: orbits around Kepler-538
charts.description: The orbits of Kepler-538's planets in this map from above, to scale, with Kepler-538 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Holczer et al. 2016 (2016ApJS..225....9H), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname HOLCZER_ET_AL__2016): P 81.73764829 d

charts.title: Kepler-538 b: its transit
charts.description: Kepler-538 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (81, 82, 83) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 28227113, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 6 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 7 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 27-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 6 min late; 27-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 2 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
